project_type: Next.js 14 TypeScript multi-tenant SaaS CRM with Drizzle ORM + PostgreSQL
build_system: npm/pnpm with Next.js build, vitest for testing
test_framework: vitest with tests/**/*.test.ts pattern, setupFiles in vitest.setup.ts
verification_instructions: Run typecheck (npx tsc --noEmit) and unit tests (npx vitest run) to confirm no regressions
setup_instructions: npm install or pnpm install to set up node_modules
environment_constraints: OPEN_INTERNET mode - full network access. Node >= 22.
contribution_requirements: Branch fix/critical-app-scan-7 from gh/main. Tests under tests/unit/. Vitest config at vitest.config.ts with @/ alias resolving to project root.
key_patterns: API routes in app/api/, lib/ for shared logic, drizzle/schema/ for DB schema, zod for validation in lib/api/schemas.ts, requireAuth middleware for auth, db transactions with drizzle tx pattern, cache module at lib/cache/index.ts using ioredis
directory_structure: app/api/ - API routes, lib/ - shared libraries, drizzle/ - DB schema and client, tests/ - test files, components/ - React components
